ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_carve: Cuts identical Предмет entities, Создание them into Ступени. Works on Камень и Дерево only. §a[Create Рецепт: Cutting]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_pack: Condenses identical Предмет entities, Создание them into 2x2 recipes. §a[Create Рецепт: Pack]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_polish: Refines Предмет entities into their polished variants. §a[Create Рецепт: Polish]
ars_technica.glyph_desc.glyph_obliterate: Obliterates foes by sheer force with an Магический hammer. Can be augmented with Sensitive to process Предмет entities. §a[Create Рецепт: Crushing Wheels]

ars_technica.page1.processing: Арс Техника adds glyphs that perform Create-style processing: Pressing, Polishing, Mixing, Crushing, и more. Hover the glyphs below for Create Рецепт details.
ars_technica.page2.processing:
Depot support: Only Нажмите, Polish, Obliterate, и Whirl work when cast on a Create Depot. Cast on the depot to automate processing from its inventory.

ars_technica.page1.arcane_wrench: The Магический Wrench is Create's Wrench augmented with Ars Nouveau Магия. Obtain it by enchanting a Create Wrench in the Enchanting Apparatus.

- Relays: Правый-Щёлкните to convert a Relay into a Precise Relay to configure its cooldown
